identity.name: NOC Commander
identity.description: A high-precision, tactical monitoring interface designed for clarity and speed. It eschews decorative gradients for high-contrast data visualization.
principles: Zero Noise: If it's not data or a critical action, remove it.
Tactical Clarity: Use color ONLY for status (Green/Red/Yellow). UI chrome should be invisible.
Density with Breath: High data density in tables, but clear separation between widgets.
Optical Precision: Align everything to the pixel. No fuzzy edges.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install 'recharts' for data visualization: `npm install recharts` or `yarn add recharts`.
Use 'Public Sans' for all body text and 'Manrope' for headings. Update tailwind.config.js to include these.
For the 'Performance Pro' Light look, maintain strict whitespace. Do not clutter.
Use the color palette provided in the 'colors' section. Update css variables in index.css.
Ensure all interactive elements have `data-testid` attributes.
Implement the 'Bento Grid Mode B' for the main dashboard view.
Prioritize 'Red/Green/Amber' indicators for status over generic blues.
Create a 'Sidebar' layout for navigation to maximize vertical screen real estate for data.
universal_guidelines: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects sparingly in this Light theme (mostly for sticky headers).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. This results in breaking transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
